name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
description: The Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) dataset is a large-scale multilingual corpus derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox, consisting of 44.5K hours of English and about 6K hours for seven other languages, intended for speech research.
license: The dataset is released under an open license as it is derived from LibriVox and Project Gutenberg data, which are in the public domain.
inLanguage: English, German, Dutch, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, Polish
citeAs: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert. Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS): A Large-Scale Multilingual Dataset for Speech Research. Facebook AI Research, December 22, 2020.

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected by downloading audiobooks from LibriVox using LibriLight tools, segmenting audio files into 10-20 second segments, and generating pseudo labels using acoustic models.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Text-To-Speech (TTS) research.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The data is completely de-identified, and only audio from publicly shared videos was used for training acoustic models.
